filters.name: Conditional Vertex Selection
filters.shortDescription: Selects vertices for which a boolean expression evaluates true.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Boolean function using muparser to perform vertex selection on the current mesh.
You can use muparser built-in operators and functions, such as `&&`, `||`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`, `!=`, `==`, and the ternary `cond ? a : b`. Custom random helpers are also available: `rnd()` in `[0,1]` and `randInt(a)` in `[0,a)`.
Variables: `x,y,z` (position), `nx,ny,nz` (normal), `r,g,b,a` (color), `q` (quality), `vi` (index), `vtu,vtv,ti` (texture), `vsel` (selection). Bounding box: `xmin,ymin,zmin`, `xmax,ymax,zmax`, `xmid,ymid,zmid`, `xdim,ydim,zdim`, `bbdiag`.

filters.name: Conditional Face Selection
filters.shortDescription: Selects faces for which a boolean expression evaluates true.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Boolean function using muparser to perform face selection on the current mesh.
You can use muparser built-in operators and functions, such as `&&`, `||`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`, `!=`, `==`, and the ternary `cond ? a : b`. Custom random helpers are also available: `rnd()` in `[0,1]` and `randInt(a)` in `[0,a)`.
Variables: `fi` (face index), `fr,fg,fb,fa` (face color), `fq` (face quality), `fnx,fny,fnz` (face normal), `fsel` (selection). Per-vertex: `x0,y0,z0`, `x1,y1,z1`, `x2,y2,z2`, `q0,q1,q2`, `vsel0,vsel1,vsel2`. Bounding box: `xmin,ymin,zmin`, `xmax,ymax,zmax`, `bbdiag`.

filters.name: Per Vertex Geometric Function
filters.shortDescription: Computes new per-vertex coordinates from expressions.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Geometric function using muparser to generate new coordinates. You can change `x,y,z` for every vertex according to the specified expressions.
Variables: `x,y,z` (position), `nx,ny,nz` (normal), `r,g,b,a` (color), `q` (quality), `vi` (index), `vtu,vtv,ti` (texture), `vsel` (selection). Bounding box: `xmin,ymin,zmin`, `xmax,ymax,zmax`, `bbdiag`.

parameters.label: Only On Selection
parameters.help: If enabled, the filter affects only selected elements.

filters.name: Per Vertex Normal Function
filters.shortDescription: Computes new per-vertex normals from expressions.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Normal function using muparser to generate a new normal for each vertex.
Variables: `x,y,z` (position), `nx,ny,nz` (normal), `r,g,b,a` (color), `q` (quality), `vi` (index), `vtu,vtv,ti` (texture), `vsel` (selection). Bounding box: `xmin,ymin,zmin`, `xmax,ymax,zmax`, `bbdiag`.

parameters.label: Only On Selection
parameters.help: If enabled, the filter affects only selected elements.

filters.name: Per Face Normal Function
filters.shortDescription: Computes new per-face normals from expressions.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Normal function using muparser to generate a new normal for each face.
Variables: `fi` (face index), `fnx,fny,fnz` (face normal), `fr,fg,fb,fa` (face color), `fq` (face quality), `fsel` (selection). Per-vertex: `x0,y0,z0`, `x1,y1,z1`, `x2,y2,z2`. Bounding box: `xmin,ymin,zmin`, `xmax,ymax,zmax`, `bbdiag`.

parameters.label: Only On Selection
parameters.help: If enabled, the filter affects only selected elements.

filters.name: Per Vertex Color Function
filters.shortDescription: Computes per-vertex RGBA colors from expressions.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Color function using muparser to generate new RGBA values for each vertex. Red, green, blue and alpha channels are defined by expressions.
Variables: `x,y,z` (position), `nx,ny,nz` (normal), `r,g,b,a` (color, 0-255), `q` (quality), `vi` (index), `vtu,vtv,ti` (texture), `vsel` (selection). Bounding box: `xmin,ymin,zmin`, `xmax,ymax,zmax`, `bbdiag`.

parameters.label: Alpha Function
parameters.help: Expression for alpha output in range [0, 255].

parameters.label: Only On Selection
parameters.help: If enabled, the filter affects only selected elements.

filters.name: Per Vertex Quality Function
filters.shortDescription: Computes per-vertex scalar quality from an expression.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Quality function using muparser to compute a new scalar quality for each vertex.
Variables: `x,y,z` (position), `nx,ny,nz` (normal), `r,g,b,a` (color), `q` (quality), `vi` (index), `vtu,vtv,ti` (texture), `vsel` (selection). Bounding box: `xmin,ymin,zmin`, `xmax,ymax,zmax`, `bbdiag`. User-defined per-vertex attributes are also available.

parameters.label: Map To Color
parameters.help: Maps computed quality into per-vertex color.

parameters.label: Only On Selection
parameters.help: If enabled, the filter affects only selected elements.

Bounding box: `xmin,ymin,zmin`, `xmax,ymax,zmax`, `bbdiag`. User-defined per-face attributes are also available.

filters.name: Per Wedge Texture Function
filters.shortDescription: Computes per-wedge texture coordinates from expressions.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Texture function using muparser to generate new per-wedge texture coordinates for each face. You can define six expressions (`u0,v0,u1,v1,u2,v2`).
Variables: `fi` (face index), `fr,fg,fb,fa` (face color), `fq` (face quality), `fnx,fny,fnz` (face normal), `fsel` (selection). Per-vertex: `x0,y0,z0`, `x1,y1,z1`, `x2,y2,z2`, `wtu0,wtv0`, `wtu1,wtv1`, `wtu2,wtv2`, `ti`. Bounding box: `xmin,ymin,zmin`, `xmax,ymax,zmax`, `bbdiag`.

parameters.label: Only On Selection
parameters.help: If enabled, the filter affects only selected elements.

filters.name: Define New Per Vertex Custom Scalar Attribute
filters.shortDescription: Defines and fills a custom per-vertex scalar attribute.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Adds a new per-vertex custom scalar attribute and fills it with the specified expression. Attribute names must contain only letters, numbers and underscores. The chosen name can be used in other function filters.
Variables: `x,y,z` (position), `nx,ny,nz` (normal), `r,g,b,a` (color), `q` (quality), `vi` (index), `vtu,vtv,ti` (texture), `vsel` (selection). Bounding box: `xmin,ymin,zmin`, `xmax,ymax,zmax`, `bbdiag`. All custom vertex attributes are available.

parameters.label: Attribute Name
parameters.help: Name of the new custom attribute.

parameters.label: Scalar Function
parameters.help: Expression used to compute the scalar attribute.

filters.name: Grid Generator
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Generates a new 2D grid mesh with user-defined vertex counts on X and Y, absolute size on both axes, and optional centering on origin.

parameters.label: Center On Origin
parameters.help: Centers the generated grid on origin.

filters.name: Implicit Surface
filters.shortDescription: Extracts an isosurface from an implicit scalar field.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Generates a new mesh corresponding to the `0` isovalue of a scalar field sampled from the given expression inside the specified 3D range.

parameters.label: Voxel Size
parameters.help: Sampling step used for volumetric evaluation.

parameters.label: Field Function
parameters.help: Scalar field expression f(x,y,z). The 0-isovalue is extracted.

filters.name: Refine User-Defined
filters.shortDescription: Refines edges selected by an expression and places split points by expressions.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Refines the current mesh with user-defined expressions.
A boolean predicate selects edges to split, and three expressions define the position of each inserted vertex.
You can use muparser built-in operators and functions, such as `&&`, `||`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`, `!=`, `==`, and the ternary `cond ? a : b`. Custom random helpers: `rnd()` in `[0,1]` and `randInt(a)` in `[0,a)`.
Edge endpoint variables: `x0,y0,z0` and `x1,y1,z1`, normals `nx0,ny0,nz0` and `nx1,ny1,nz1`, colors `r0,g0,b0` and `r1,g1,b1`, quality `q0,q1`.

parameters.label: Edge Predicate
parameters.help: Boolean expression used to decide whether an edge is refined.
